opening.argument: Judge, consider the price outlook alongside the trading link. The speaker describes a possible move toward higher prices after a wave pattern develops [1]. The description then offers a direct route to trade on Bybit [2]. Those elements do not amount to an explicit instruction to buy AVAX, but the combination gives a viewer both a reason to anticipate appreciation and a place to act on it. The conditional language limits the prediction; it does not remove the promotional function of placing an affiliate trading link beside the analysis.
